title: Author the versioned WP1 augmented example package with complete inventories and preservation maps (F4 missing evidence)
body:
## Goal
Author one new, separately identified example package `wp1-examples-0121-v1` under `benchmark/writing/` that supplies the evidence review #574 finding F4 found missing: augmented example answers with complete before/after workspace and dependency inventories, immutable-original and license evidence, delivered-notice evidence, and original/output map relations covering every preservation ID. Reviews #574 and #581 both name this as the smallest missing content (see Context). Expected gain: a committed package plus a repository-only checker that the next shaper can hand to a separate pinned reviewer; the verdict line the next shaper reads is the package status `proposed-awaiting-separate-check` and the checker exit code. This task does NOT lift F4: `wp1-key-0119` stays byte-identical, its established-key use and both example map slots stay blocked until a separate review of this package. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native validity, behaviour, build, dependency resolution or save-version preservation. The examples are authored preparation controls under stated hypothetical conditions, never trial results or agent output.
## Acceptance
- [ ] FIRST record observed HEAD/tree and verify the SHA256 pins in Context against actual bytes (staged reviewer input included). Write the result to `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121-pre-edit.md` before authoring anything else; on a material mismatch stop and report it instead of authoring.
- [ ] In the same pre-edit file, list from the actual sources (method.json task 4 and common leaves, protocol answer/grading/preservation clauses, README scope, `wp1-key-0119.json` `/finding_dispositions/F4` and each affected `/evidence_reservation`) every item a complete preservation map and inventory must contain, each with its exact locator. Derive counts and ID lists from those files, not from this task text or from report summaries. If a requirement cannot be met from repository bytes alone, mark it unavailable with the reason; do not weaken or reinterpret it.
- [ ] Author `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121.json` and `.md`: new example identities (do not reuse the names C1-correct / C1-unverified-extra as if they were the historical answers; reference them as predecessors by hash). Each augmented example carries: complete pre and post workspace/dependency inventories (path, kind, size, SHA256, raw-byte reference), immutable-original and license before/after evidence, notice evidence, and a map relation for every preservation ID, with correctness and grounding kept as separate prescriptions. The post-state project bytes may only be the deterministic output the existing accepted WP1 definition fixes (the single documented text change to the pinned original); derive them in the checker from the pinned original and state plainly that this is an authored expected output, not a produced or natively validated file. Keep at least one complete positive example and the unverified-extra variant; keep the unverified extra visibly unverified.
- [ ] Historical raw answers, `wp1-key-0119.*`, `wp1-key-0117.*`, all preserved 0118 review artifacts, `method.json`, `protocol.md`, `benchmark/real-project-0107/*`, `benchmark/preparation.json` and `benchmark/sources.*` remain byte-identical. No readiness, index or proposal promotion. Status of the new package is `proposed-awaiting-separate-check`; `benchmark_ready` stays false.
- [ ] Preserve the staged reviewer artifact unchanged as `benchmark/writing/wp1-disposition-review-0120.json` (exact bytes, pin in Context) and record its provenance (issue #581, reviewed HEAD/tree as stated inside the artifact) in the Markdown. Do not re-run any of its checks to do this.
- [ ] Write `benchmark/writing/check_wp1_examples_0121.py` (standard library, repository reads only, writes nothing, does not import or execute historical checkers or the preserved audit). It verifies: all pins, the unchanged-file set above, inventory completeness against the requirement list, re-derived expected output hash/size, every preservation ID mapped in every example, the 0119 F4 block still intact, and rejecting controls for at least: a missing inventory entry, a wrong hash, a missing preservation ID, an invented sidecar file, a mutated original or license, and complete-map credit given to the historical raw answers. Save its observed command, exit code and output summary in `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121-verification.json`.
- [ ] The report states what is complete, what stayed unavailable and why, the hashes of the new files, and that C1 human adjudication, native, allocation/isolation, independent method review, owner acceptance and readiness gaps remain open.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_examples_0121.py
## Context
- `.session/inputs/581-wp1-disposition-review-0120.json` (staged; size 38470, SHA256 bd2cd46a79bfcaf56a033b631c5b29196545283a547af86c6bcb8e9150c54141): review #581 agreed with all seven F3 mappings and judged the F4 blocked disposition adequate but F4 not cleared; its report names this package as the smallest next step.
- `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.md`, section "What next": the author of 0119 lists the same missing content and the conditions (new identity, historical raw answers preserved, no unseen sidecars, no weakened mapping requirements).
- SHA256 pins read from `wp1-key-0119.md` "Scoped file hashes": wp1-key-0119.json 2afdca4bfc6feaa9464348bed7709b0657ea1ccbbe5d6b0a33b549c78f41c142; check_wp1_key_0119.py 28ee70435c6a4fea7a79d942e7d90e9e3174ec31d64d741f93447000bc093d99; wp1-key-review-0118.json 410b0ebf7d3135521d10bd32d3b1102769caa848f5e5c7278d8e9a29eefd9a55; method.json 276f2881c70eae311195a4cc0a802e316ca06a206a0f1d16e7f041205fd3b0ac; benchmark/protocol.md 1aeb83227dc11761160ff80d24eb03a216a2531d90c1a6d10ccb25bb85c7eb2f; benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj (5806 bytes) 1d5e140df788ce1f91c89241bbdb1227c5e4cc6fdf6efbbd820974bbe6082dcf; benchmark/real-project-0107/LICENSE.txt (1060 bytes) 529e65e6fc185d39380efd3957ef1c9acd0aac31ed288bcb9d124840861f03a2. wp1-key-0119.md itself: 5f18384ed27e6b995426704f40316e69ee09a52084767304c15738f6e78980ac.
- The shaper did not read method.json, protocol.md or the key JSON: requirement counts, ID lists and the exact WP1 change locator must come from those files.
- Review #581 observed HEAD 19d43f01e6022a8ab269f04b2b88c12c98bf53b3; your HEAD will differ by administrative commits. Disclose the difference; scoped-byte equality is what matters.
## Budget
Read whole: `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.md`, `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119-pre-edit-findings.md`, `benchmark/writing/README.md`, `benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj`, `benchmark/real-project-0107/LICENSE.txt`, `benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0119.py` (as a pattern for the checker). Query, do not dump: `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.json` (`/finding_dispositions/F4`, affected example ledgers and evidence reservations, required IDs, raw-answer references), `benchmark/writing/method.json` (`/common/answer_rule`, `/tasks/4` request, preservation, output_manifest_rule, trial_artifacts), `benchmark/protocol.md` cited lines L26-41 and L60, `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-review-0118.json` `/findings/1` only, and the staged reviewer artifact's F4 section. Use short `python3 -I -c` queries with bounded output. Do not read: global gap maps, 0115/0116 packages, POC material under `docs/research/poc/`, `sources.json`. Do not run: the preserved `wp1-review-audit-0118.py`, historical checkers or builders, agent arms, the frozen #544 checker. No source regeneration, no new project selection, no edits outside `benchmark/writing/`. No `git commit`, shell expansion, pipes or redirection; the parent commits. Engine verification has no `.session/` inputs and no LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT, so the checker must rely on repository files only (hence the committed copy of the reviewer artifact). If turns run short, save the pre-edit file and the JSON first and report `partial` with what is missing.
